title: Promptless: Bounce Back
tagline: Every AI went dark. Your old computer didn't.

replies.no_attachment: Message bounced back: you forgot the photo??

help: needed: ls grep open cd man
also: cat head less echo pwd
alias: alias open='pixview'   # set up by the previous owner
shell.mv_readonly: mv: cannot move '{file}': Read-only file system
shell.man_usage: What manual page do you want?

ls: List the files in a folder.
the ones whose names start with .
grep: Print the lines of FILE that contain WORD.
Capitals count: Gold is not gold.
open: Open a picture in its viewer window.
man: Show the manual page for COMMAND.
head: HEAD(1)
head [-n N] FILE
Print the first N lines (10 if not given).
pwd: Print the folder you are in.
ps: List running programs and their numbers.
cp: Copy a file. Client files aren't yours:
copy them home (~) to change them.
chmod: chmod +r FILE   let it be read
chmod +x FILE   let a script run
Only works on files you own (in ~).
kill: Stop a program. Every window shows
its number in the title bar. See ps.

shell.kill_usage: usage: kill PID   (the number in a window's title bar)
shell.kill_protected: kill: ({pid}) - not that one. {cmd} is holding this whole machine together.
shell.open_script: open: {file} is a script. run it with ./{file}
